eligibility_reason: Original predictive-density and companion findings are independently valid reproduction targets, but their final-paper correspondence, complete source observations and computational recipe remain unresolved. This is independent of improvement eligibility; historical correlation controls and known printed WAIC values do not establish reproduction.

source_paper.title: Hippocampal astrocytic sequences emerge during learning and memory recall

evidence.locator: Abstract; Figures 2–5; Data and Code availability
evidence.supports: Calcium-event sequences in fear conditioning and conditioned-context recall, with behavior association.

evidence.locator: Files; Using the imaging data; Scope
evidence.supports: Released collections/traces/derived exports/behavior and archived code revision 5be84b4; some supplementary notebooks retain absolute paths.

evidence.locator: run_cross_validated_analysis; odd/even event split; Argmaxes; Spearman correlation
evidence.supports: Within-animal odd/even source-ordering correlation and shuffle diagnostics; this legacy calculation is distinct from the peak-time density-model WAIC endpoint.
Cubic interpolation, clipped event window and event-averaged traces.

evidence.locator: May 25, 2026 preprint version 2; Figure 2h and Results paragraphs on peak distributions; Figure 4e–f; Extended Data Figure 17c
evidence.supports: Ordered WAIC predictive comparisons of power-law, exponential, Gaussian and uniform peak-time distributions; includes conditioning, recall-context and sex-stratified analyses. This evidence identifies a preprint endpoint, not a verified final-paper baseline.

evidence.locator: Methods, Hierarchical Bayesian Model; Results preceding Figure 2h
evidence.supports: Gaussian-shaped temporal receptive fields provide inferred peak times; source excludes conditioning peaks during shock (<2 seconds) for the distribution comparison. Final-version preprocessing/likelihood parity is not established.

evidence.locator: Results preceding Figure2h; Figure4d; Extended Data Figures7 and16
evidence.supports: Inferred peak-location distribution summaries accompany the density comparisons; they derive from fitted cell/event temporal responses. May2026 preprint evidence only; final-paper correspondence unresolved.

evidence.locator: Results accompanying Extended Data Figure17a-d and Supplemental Table1
evidence.supports: Sex-stratified event-count controls, peak distributions, all four density comparisons and power-law exponent posteriors must remain distinct. May2026 preprint evidence only; final-paper correspondence unresolved.

evidence.locator: Results habituation analysis; Extended Data Figure20b-e
evidence.supports: Habituation event-count and individual-sequence controls precede the density comparison; the text and Figure20e caption disagree on uniform WAIC1192.9 versus1192.2. May2026 preprint evidence only; final-paper correspondence unresolved.

Peak-width versus peak-time slope and repeated-event peak-variability contrasts are temporal-model companions; neither is a WAIC substitute. May2026 preprint evidence only; final-paper correspondence unresolved.

target.description: Recover the original predictive-density comparison for inferred astrocytic peak times. The May 2026 preprint uses WAIC to compare four distribution families during conditioning and recall; final-paper endpoint correspondence must be verified before activation.

dataset.description: Zenodo 21780255 and archived revision 5be84b4 supply traces and derived data. The exact peak-time inputs/posterior summaries used by each final-version WAIC comparison have not been authenticated.

cohort.description: Preprint density comparisons cover conditioning and both recall contexts, including sex-stratified recall analyses. Exact final-paper animal/cell inclusion and every source comparison row must be reconciled; the local 21-record prefix component is not this model-input census.

split.description: WAIC is the source predictive-performance estimator; the reviewed text does not establish a separately held-animal test set for density fitting. Recover its original observation units and fit/evaluation access. Odd/even event sorting belongs to the distinct correlation analysis; a newly held-mouse split would be an extension.

inputs.description: Source density models use peak times inferred from hierarchical temporal-response fits. Recover the exact original posterior-summary or uncertainty treatment and allowed fitting inputs; sequence labels are not required for this density-estimation task.

preprocessing.description: The preprint fits Gaussian-shaped temporal fields and excludes conditioning peaks below two seconds for distribution comparison. Exact final-paper event support, time windows, priors, peak extraction and code binding remain unverified; the legacy 3303-frame correlation recipe cannot substitute for them.

metric.description: WAIC, lower is better, is explicitly used for predictive density comparison. Recover the source deviance/log-score convention, pointwise likelihood, posterior calculation and effective-complexity term rather than assuming a generic WAIC implementation matches the published numbers.

aggregation.description: Source reports separate context and sex-group distribution comparisons. Exact pointwise likelihood aggregation and model-comparison uncertainty must be recovered; cell observations, events and posterior draws cannot automatically be treated as independent biological mice.

full_panel.description: Preserve all four density-family WAIC comparisons in conditioning, recall A, recall B and each recall context separately for females and males. The inspected habituation source supports power-law and uniform comparisons; any other habituation-family rows require source authentication and are not declared scalar findings here. Retain complete inferred-peak distributions, sex-stratified power-law exponent posterior arrays, event-count/sequence controls and temporal width/variability companions. Posterior arrays without an identified source point summary must not be reduced to invented scalar findings. Complete final-version tables, arrays and animal/cell support remain unauthenticated, so the scalar list is not a complete representation of the original panel.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions must share the same source-paper version, authentic original traces or source-admitted inferred-peak inputs, animal/cell/event identities, context/sex labels and declared published-result exposure. The author-code condition adds only the authenticated matching analysis source. The legacy21-case3303-frame correlation packet is not the full density-model panel; complete peak-model inputs, final-version correspondence and matching author-code manifest are unresolved.
